verdict.rationale: Including multiple project directories in one session is a fair question for a coding agent, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents multi-root workspaces or adding several directories to a single session. "Run agent sessions in any folder" describes choosing one folder per session, and Kanban worktrees and subagents are separate parallel contexts, not one session spanning several directories.

support.subject: As a developer, I can include multiple project directories in a single session for broader context
